purpose: Human review queue for matching each scheduled recipe with its own food photo and genuinely matching cooking video. Do not set approval flags until the actual media has been visually reviewed.
rules: Photo must visibly depict the named dish, not merely a related cuisine or ingredient.
Do not reuse the same photo URL for different recipes unless the actual image is genuinely the same dish (normally reject duplicates).
Video must show the same dish or a clearly disclosed, closely matching variation; confirm footage, not only title or URL.
Only set image_verified=true and video_verified=true in recipes.json after review.
